catalogue.name: The Scandinavian Commonwealth
catalogue.readme:
Force generation

The lists are divided into three unit categories; Command, Core and Special. When generating forces players must include:
● One (1) Command entry
● Max one (1) Special entry for each Core entry
● Max two (2) upgrades per full 300 points in their force. (Unless otherwise specified, a unit may only take an upgrade once).

Players get 1 Faction Point per full 300 points in their force, and can spend them during force generation to exceed the limits above - one (1) FP lets you take:
● One (1) additional Command entry, (to a maximum of two (2))
● One (1) extra Special entry 
● Two (2) additional upgrades

Cost types:
p: Points
U: Upgrades
FP: Faction Points

sharedRules.name: Stabiliser
sharedRules.description: The model has Move and Fire.

sharedRules.name: Rangefinder
sharedRules.description: The model adds 3” to all its ranged weapon ranges.

sharedRules.name: Velocity Compensator
sharedRules.description: The model’s weapon systems with range greater than 12” has antiair.

sharedRules.name: antiair(LGMs)
sharedRules.description: May attack aircraft normally and VTOL without hit modifier with LGMs.

sharedRules.name: Superiority of Emancipation
sharedRules.description:
Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Standoff missile: make one (1) free Laser- guided missile attack with hit(auto) instead of hit(potshots) versus any target with Lock tokens. Discard 1 token from the target.
● Tactical retreat: one (1) friendly unit moves up to 6” towards its own board edge.
● Jamming: use in the initiative phase. Until end of turn, cancel any enemy FP use on 4+.

sharedRules.name: Weapon link
sharedRules.description: One (1) of the model’s weapon systems has Dual.

sharedRules.name: Visionary Colony
sharedRules.description:
Þungur hnífur: add energy sword w attack(+1) to weapon systems (5p, max 1).
May not field Scandinavian Aircraft.
Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Shoot and scoot: as a reaction, one (1) unit may attack with ranged weapons and then make one (1) move without priority.
● Strike and retreat: one (1) friendly unit gets Superior Withdrawal until end of turn.
● Close Quarters drill: one (1) friendly unit gets pistol(6”) until end of turn.

sharedRules.name: Inherit(Vanguard)
sharedRules.description: If all models without Inherit(Vanguard) in this unit has Vanguard (or better), this model has Vanguard.

sharedRules.name: Attach(scandinavian soldiers)
sharedRules.description: Model may attach to one unit of scandinavian soldiers before game, becoming part of the unit for all purposes. When allocating wounds, this model is exempt from the “wounded models take precedence” rule.

sharedRules.name: Attach(line battleframes)
sharedRules.description: Model may attach to one unit of line battleframes before game, becoming part of the unit for all purposes. When allocating wounds, this model is exempt from the “wounded models take precedence” rule.

sharedRules.name: Support Turret
sharedRules.description: Does not start deployed with the unit. When activated unit may deploy turret in cohesion. Unit may voluntarily remove the turret as a casualty when moving.

sharedRules.name: Greyport Armoury
sharedRules.description:
Unoffical Units and Weapon Options
- Dual Barrage cannon upgrade for Hover APC

sharedRules.name: Tactical AU Controller
sharedRules.description: Slaved AUs in the same unit lose Inaccurate. This unit can take the Slaved AU 5p upgrade once per controller, without using an upgrade slot.
